gen-dafont-college-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: Curves and stems in College share one stroke width, which gives the display letters a punchy build. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps its lowercase close to cap height, so text stays compact beside it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sono: College carries a blueprint-lettering feel, its curves drawn with the same line as its stems. Sono, with generous letter spacing and open-mouthed lowercase a shapes, lets paragraphs unfold at an unhurried pace.
gen-dafont-college-gf-stack-sans-notch: College is a display face whose curves match its stems in thickness, with generous openings inside each letter. Stack Sans Notch backs it with rod-like lines and see-into curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-stack-sans-text: College is a display face with a dynamic, authoritative bearing and no thin strokes anywhere. Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like line with curve endings held well apart, which reads modern.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sulphur-point: College is stout and authoritative, its curves carrying as much weight as its stems. And College belongs big and in short lines, with Sulphur Point's open-gapped, marker-like sans line below.
gen-dafont-college-gf-ubuntu-sans: College draws curves and straight stems with matching stroke width, giving its display letters a blunt, dynamic punch. Ubuntu Sans runs on like bent copper pipe, large-eyed throughout.
gen-dafont-college-gf-vend-sans: Nothing in College gets thin: curves and stems carry the same stroke, giving a bold display voice. Vend Sans, drawn with a ruler-like line and unclosed curve endings, keeps long text running smoothly.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-alexandria: Geometric to the core, Conthrax has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and capitals that barely rise above its lowercase. Alexandria joins in with open c terminals and short stems, keeping things clean.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari has distinctly open letter mouths and a modern, neutral build. Geometric Conthrax, where curves and straights share a single width, belongs big and brief at the top.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-kannada: The text here reads contemporary and squared-off, like woodblock letters whose terminals stop far from the stem. Anek Kannada carries the body, while Conthrax, with a uniform-width w, goes big and short.
